description: Playwright checks websites in real browsers. These lessons use tiny local page examples so you can learn locators, actions and assertions without needing an online account. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain assertions wait for a result

seo.title: Playwright Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Playwright with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
